mapper.sql: emp00_person_id AS person_id , emp00_org_code_id AS org_code_id , ( SELECT i.org02_kor_nm FROM org02_info i WHERE i.org02_code_id = emp00_org_code_id AND i.org02_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(y.org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info y WHERE y.org02_code_id = i.org02_code_id AND y.org02_mod_date <= emp00_date ) ) AS org_kor_name , f_cdnm('EmpTitleCode', emp00_title_cd, emp00_company_id, emp00_date) AS title_name , CASE WHEN COALESCE(emp00_grade_cd, '00') = '00' THEN f_cdnm('EmpTitleCode', emp00_title_cd, emp00_company_id, emp00_date) ELSE f_cdnm('EmpGradeCode', emp00_grade_cd, emp00_company_id, emp00_date) END AS title_name2 , emp00_kor_nm AS emp_kor_name
mapper.select:
WITH RECURSIVE org_down(org_code_id, depth) AS ( SELECT CAST(#{orgCodeId} AS NUMERIC), 0 UNION ALL SELECT b.org02_code_id, d.depth + 1 FROM org_down d INNER JOIN org02_info b ON b.org02_parent_code_id = d.org_code_id WHERE d.depth < 20 AND b.org02_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info x WHERE x.org02_code_id = b.org02_code_id AND x.org02_mod_date <= f_sysdate() ) ), SELECT FROM emp00 WHERE 1 = 1
AND emp00_trans_cd <= '899' AND ( emp00_kor_nm || COALESCE(( SELECT i.org02_kor_nm FROM org02_info i WHERE i.org02_code_id = emp00_org_code_id AND i.org02_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(y.org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info y WHERE y.org02_code_id = i.org02_code_id AND y.org02_mod_date <= emp00_date ) ), '') || COALESCE(emp00_emp_no, '') || COALESCE(f_cdnm('EmpTitleCode', emp00_title_cd, emp00_company_id, emp00_date), '') ) LIKE '%' || #{searchText} || '%' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = emp00_person_id AND ( emp04_start_date > f_today() OR COALESCE(emp04_close_date, '9999-12-31') < f_today() ) )
AND emp00_org_code_id = #{orgCodeId} AND f_today() BETWEEN emp00_date AND COALESCE(emp00_close_date, f_today()) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = emp00_person_id AND ( emp04_start_date > f_today() OR COALESCE(emp04_close_date, '9999-12-31') < f_today() ) )
AND emp00_trans_cd <= '799'
AND emp00_org_code_id IN (SELECT org_code_id FROM org_down) AND emp00_org_code_id = #{orgCodeId}
AND emp00_trans_cd <= '799'
ORDER BY ( SELECT org01_org_cd FROM org01_code WHERE org01_code_id = emp00_org_code_id ) , emp00_title_cd, emp00_pos_cd, emp00_order_seq
WITH SELECT emp00_person_id AS person_id, emp00_pos_cd AS pos_code FROM emp00 WHERE emp00_person_id IN #{id}

SELECT a.apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', a.apr01_status_cd, #{companyId}, a.apr01_reg_date) AS status_name , a.apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS class_tree_name_allpath , a.apr01_title AS title FROM apr01_appr a INNER JOIN apr04_appr_step b ON a.apr01_appr_id = b.apr04_appr_id WHERE a.apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('99') AND b.apr04_step_status_cd IN ('20','30') AND f_trunc(apr04_appr_date) BETWEEN f_add_day(#{toDay}, -7) AND #{toDay} AND a.apr01_reg_emp_id = #{personId} ORDER BY a.apr01_reg_date DESC, a.apr01_appr_id DESC

SELECT a.apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', a.apr01_status_cd, #{companyId}, a.apr01_reg_date) AS status_name , a.apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , c.dcr01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name_allpath , a.apr01_title AS title FROM ( SELECT a.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.apr01_class_tree_id ORDER BY apr01_reg_date DESC) AS rn FROM apr01_appr a INNER JOIN apr04_appr_step b ON a.apr01_appr_id = b.apr04_appr_id WHERE a.apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('99') AND b.apr04_step_status_cd IN ('20','30') AND a.apr01_reg_emp_id = #{personId} AND a.apr01_title LIKE #{searchText} ) a INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree c ON a.apr01_class_tree_id = c.dcr01_class_tree_id WHERE a.rn = 1 ORDER BY a.apr01_reg_date DESC, a.apr01_appr_id DESC

SELECT apr04_appr_step_id AS appr_step_id , apr04_seq AS seq , apr04_step_type_cd AS step_type_code , apr04_step_status_cd AS step_status_code , apr04_step_emp_id AS step_emp_id , apr04_lock_yn AS lock_yn , apr04_add_emp_id AS add_emp_id , apr04_appr_date AS appr_date FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = #{apprId} ORDER BY LPAD(apr04_seq, 4, '0')
mapper.update: UPDATE apr04_appr_step SET apr04_seq = #{seq} WHERE apr04_appr_step_id = #{apprStepId} AND apr04_appr_id = #{apprId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_step_id = #{apprStepId} AND apr04_appr_id = #{apprId}
